name: Escape the Job

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
The second sandbox is not privileged — but someone left the Docker socket inside it. That is the whole game: whoever can reach the daemon can ask it to start a new container, with whatever mounts they choose, and that container runs on the host.

Stand up the local build-job lab (see lab/README.md). A flag exists only on the real host, outside every build container. Don't attack the sandbox you're in — use the socket to launch one that lands you on the host filesystem, then go and find it. The path isn't advertised, and the flag may not be stored in the clear.
hints: The attack isn't on your container — it's a request to the daemon. What does -v /:/host give a container you start?
Once you're on the host filesystem, enumerate — it isn't where the last flag was, and you may need to decode what you find.

deployment.notes: Local lab with a mounted Docker socket. Players run the lab on their own machine; see lab/README.md. Do not run on shared/production hosts.
